deterministic_findings.title: Agent volunteered the name 'Krishna' before the caller identified themselves
deterministic_findings.expected: The agent should ask who is calling, not guess from the caller ID. A phone number identifies a line, not a person.
deterministic_findings.actual: At 00:31.407 the agent proposed the name 'Krishna', which the caller had not said at any earlier point in the call.
deterministic_findings.why_it_matters: Phone numbers are shared between household members, partners and colleagues. Naming the patient associated with a number tells whoever picked up the phone who else uses that line, before establishing any right to know.

evidence.speaker: agent
evidence.quote: If you're calling from a number we have on file, am I speaking with Krishna Tejaradi?

deterministic_findings.reproduction: Place a call that creates a patient record, then call again from the same number as a different patient.

assertion_findings.title: Required information never came up in the call
assertion_findings.expected: Scenario 'new_patient_record_intake' requires the call to cover: next_step
assertion_findings.actual: Never mentioned by either party: next_step
assertion_findings.why_it_matters: The caller left the call without something the scenario says they needed, which means the task was not actually completed even if the agent sounded like it was.
